# gyro_storage_bucket (Resource)

An S3 bucket on a Gyro object storage service (Object Storage or Protected Storage). Destroy deletes the bucket (it must be empty; on Protected Storage old versions count as content).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gyro_storage_bucket" "assets" {
  service_id = 456
  name       = "assets"
}

# Protected Storage: versioned bucket with object lock (WORM).
# The real bucket name is "archive-<service code>": use full_name in S3 clients and other resources.
resource "gyro_storage_bucket" "archive" {
  service_id  = 789
  name        = "archive"
  object_lock = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Bucket name. On Protected Storage the service code is appended (see full_name). Changing it renames the bucket in place (API 2.20.0+: Object Storage changes the S3 name; Protected Storage changes the display name and website address while full_name, the S3 name, stays).
- `service_id` (Number)

### Optional

- `object_lock` (Boolean) Protected Storage only: create the bucket with object lock (WORM). Needs a free locked-bucket right (Object Lock add-on). Can only be chosen at creation and never turned off; changing it replaces the bucket. A standard Object Storage service refuses true (feature_not_available).

### Read-Only

- `full_name` (String) Real bucket name used by S3 clients and the other storage resources: name on Object Storage, <name>-<service code> on Protected Storage (on Protected Storage it keeps the original name after a rename).
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `path_url` (String)
- `versioning` (Boolean) True on Protected Storage (every bucket keeps old versions).
- `vhost_url` (String)
